# cgltf

Vendored unchanged from https://github.com/jkuhlmann/cgltf at commit
`85cd62382dfea638278962690cf515023f33ed00` (header version 1.15).

Only `cgltf.h` and its MIT license are included. The writer is not built.
`toonz/sources/glb/glbloader.cpp` is the sole implementation translation unit.
Updates must retain the license and pass the standalone GLB loader tests.
